constraints: All rows are provisional reviewer proposals, not registry mutations, staffing or capability qualification.
Canonical technical disciplines, market/problem candidates, application sectors, functions and foundries are separate axes.
Canonical register assigns S01–S29 IDs. It supplies exact names for 18 foundries and 18 application sectors, but does not give them numerical or URI IDs; none are invented here.
No function registry was present in the canonical source. Exact function-ID reconciliation remains blocked pending that source.
No inference that a KEX/BRAINK discipline already implements or resolves a physical/commercial bottleneck.
Primary and supporting responsibilities are intentionally not assigned without owner implementation review.
Public edition omits private source-document locations and full source text. Exact names/IDs, unresolved function mapping, ambiguous relationships and application gaps are retained.
